name: Caduceus for OM-3
description: Test version of v0.40: v0.30.4-alpha plus crop modes (XPan 65:24, 21:9 and 5:4 as Image Aspect choices, saved at that shape), a white Border row with a frame line in live view, our own colour film grain with a strength (1-5) and a Grain Size row, start-up safety checks, and Picture Mode waiting 30 s before it closes (#75, PR #76 by crombach). Color Mix and RGB curves on the camera, the 20 films regraded (CURVES.BIN); films, edits and Extras kept in the camera's own memory, so any SD card works

frames.note: white Frame layers: rebuilt by patch.py (frames.py), window edges measured from the stock masks
